description: Start a plain exploration of the agent: 3 rounds of up to 8 conversations that QualiLoop plans to learn what the agent does, filling System knowledge. It is not judged. It costs up to 24 conversation credits (the project's first exploration is free) and takes minutes; follow it with list_explorations. Only one runs at a time per project. To re-check what one change touched, use report_change instead.
